description: This file provides a PHP class implementation for the PDO Firebird database driver within the ADOdb database abstraction library. It includes methods for retrieving server info, metadata such as tables and columns, sequence management, and SQL query modifications tailored for Firebird databases. The file defines classes extending base ADOdb classes to handle Firebird-specific behavior.

classes.name: ADODB_pdo_firebird
classes.description: Main driver class for Firebird PDO integration, providing methods for server info, metadata, sequences, and query modifications.

classes.name: ADORecordSet_pdo_firebird
classes.description: Represents a record set specific to Firebird PDO driver extending base ADORecordSet_pdo.

classes.name: ADORecordSet_array_pdo_firebird
classes.description: Represents an array-style record set for Firebird PDO driver extending ADORecordSet_array_pdo, with specific fetch field implementation.

methods.name: serverInfo
methods.description: Determines the Firebird dialect version and retrieves server information.

methods.name: metaTables
methods.description: Fetches a list of tables in the database, utilizing the ADOdb MetaTables method.

methods.name: metaColumns
methods.description: Retrieves column metadata for a specified table, returning an array of field objects.

methods.name: metaIndexes
methods.description: Obtains index information for a specified table, including uniqueness and columns involved.

methods.name: metaPrimaryKeys
methods.description: Fetches primary key column(s) for a specified table.

methods.name: createSequence
methods.description: Creates a new database sequence with an optional starting value.

methods.name: genId
methods.description: Generates a new ID value from the sequence, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: selectLimit
methods.description: Adds LIMIT/OFFSET clauses to a SQL query for paginated results.

methods.name: _convertFieldType
methods.description: Converts database-specific field types into generic entity descriptions.

methods.name: fetchField
methods.description: Returns an ADOFieldObject describing a field from the record set.
